provider.status_reason: page doesn't mention a kids' camp, summer program or VBS

extraction.notes: No 2027 or 2026 summer camp or Vacation Bible School offering could be confirmed from accessible official sources. The website publishes campus addresses and worship schedules but no summer program details. Searches found historical VBS posts on the church's Facebook account, ourcrosslink, and a mission team's video describing VBS at the Morganton church in 2025; these do not establish a 2026 or 2027 offering. The church's Facebook homepage returned no readable content. No cards were created from older program information.

excluded.reason: A historical youth-group outing to distribute VBS flyers, with food and swimming; youth-group outings are not camps.
